clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Calor sends hunters after Nightbane Shadow Weavers in Duskwood. The disillusioned former guardsman is stationed in town, and the hunt leads through Brightwood Grove and the Rotting Orchard. Those who face the worgen can prove their mettle to Master Jonathan Carevin's monster hunters.

The Night Watch is hard pressed by undead, spiders, and outlaws along Darkshire's borders. Calor grew tired of a guard too slow and complacent to cleanse the land. He left the Watch and joined Master Jonathan Carevin, setting his blade against heresy and corruption. Carevin does not take just anyone into his circle. Those who want to aid him must first show they can survive the woods' fiercest horrors.

Feral worgen hold dominion over Brightwood Grove and the blighted Rotting Orchard. The Nightbane Shadow Weavers among them use dark magic to blind and ensnare their victims before tearing them apart. Calor sends aspiring hunters to slay these spell-weaving beasts, testing their resolve while thinning a threat whose origins deeply unsettle Darkshire's defenders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.
You believe yourself worthy to join us?
I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.
Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive, friend. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.
It is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
